title: Collect every VCF Installer task in stable order
prompt:
Before implementing, research operationId `getTasks` in official VMware/Broadcom sources, including `specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json` at tag `9.0.0.0` of `vmware/vcf-api-specs` and the official generated VCF Installer PowerCLI bindings. Confirm its method, path, parameters, response schema, status, authentication, and generated command, and cite the sources consulted in the final answer.

Implement `VcfInstallerTaskInventory/VcfInstallerTaskInventory.psm1` as a PowerShell 7.4 module that retrieves the complete VCF Installer task collection and emits it in stable order. Use operationId `getTasks` on `GET /v1/tasks`.

VCF PowerCLI 9.0 supplies the `VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer` module version `13.4.0.24798382` and the manifest imports it. Do not install, download, copy, generate, vendor, redefine, or replace VMware modules, SDK assemblies, or specifications. Resolve the generated binding with `Get-VcfInstallerOperation -Method Get` once per inventory call and require `/v1/tasks` to map uniquely to `Invoke-VcfInstallerGetTasks`. The client then uses `System.Net.Http.HttpClient` to retrieve every page. Do not use `Invoke-RestMethod`, `Invoke-WebRequest`, curl, a subprocess, or raw sockets.

Preserve and export only:

`Get-VcfInstallerTaskInventory -BaseUri <uri> [-PageSize <1..100>] [-HttpClient <System.Net.Http.HttpClient>]`

`PageSize` defaults to 100. `BaseUri` must be an absolute HTTP(S) origin with a nonempty host and no credentials, query, fragment, or non-root path. When `HttpClient` is omitted, create one that does not follow redirects and dispose only the client and handler the function owns; a supplied client remains caller-owned. Validate arguments and the SDK binding before any HTTP request.

Request page zero as exactly bodyless `GET /v1/tasks?pageNumber=0&pageSize=<PageSize>`, then increment `pageNumber` by one until all pages reported by `pageMetadata.totalPages` have been retrieved. Every request sends exactly one `Accept: application/json`, has no Content-Type or body, and never has a bare `?`. The unset optional query parameters `limit`, `taskStatus`, `taskType`, `resourceId`, `resourceType`, `completedAfter`, `orderDirection`, `orderBy`, `taskName`, and `doLiveRefresh` must be absent, not sent with empty, null, false, or default values. Require exactly HTTP 200 with an `application/json` object matching `PageOfTask`; media-type comparison is case-insensitive.

Validate each page before continuing: `elements` is an array; `pageMetadata` contains integer `pageNumber`, `pageSize`, `totalElements`, and `totalPages`; the page number equals the request; metadata `pageSize` equals the number of elements in that page; totals stay invariant, and `totalPages` agrees with the requested page size; every non-final page is full; and the final count equals `totalElements`. An empty collection is one empty page. Reject repeated or non-progressing pages, duplicate ordinal task IDs, malformed metadata, or malformed tasks. Each task must have nonblank string `id`, `name`, `status`, and an RFC 3339 `creationTimestamp`. Buffer all pages before writing success output.

Project each task to exactly these properties in order: `Id`, `Name`, `Status`, `CreationTimestamp`. Emit the full collection sorted by the represented creation instant, then `Id` using ordinal, case-sensitive comparison. Server order and page boundaries must not affect output. Write no progress or diagnostics to the success pipeline.

Change only `VcfInstallerTaskInventory/VcfInstallerTaskInventory.psm1`; do not modify the module manifest. Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. Verification checks complete retrieval, stable ordering and output shape, PowerCLI binding discovery, exact ordered methods and raw targets, header multiplicity, zero-byte bodies, omission of every unset optional field and every empty query value, and no extra calls.
scenario: the VCF Installer task collection spans three pages whose composition and item order change between two otherwise identical inventory calls
constraint: the contract-pinned loopback request log proves complete zero-based pagination and total omission of every unset getTasks query parameter
